## 席位意见(增量)· director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`), read as batch #370 item 2, 2026-10-19T06:35Z

On the triage seat's decision card (A leaned: the nightly registry canary tests `@next` until 18.0 GA and returns to `@latest` by dist-tags; B: a scaffolder-only `create-objectstack@17.7.1` whose template carries `overrides.vitest`; C: wait). The maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「继续决裁」. Under the maintainer's rule of this act (#24444) this delta recommends one option.

**Premises re-run in this act — objectstack `origin/main` `31ce45c0`:**
1. `npm view create-objectstack dist-tags` → `latest: 17.7.0`, `next: 18.0.0-next.3`, `rc: 17.0.0-rc.6`. Holds.
2. `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` job `registry-canary` (`:530`) runs `npx -y create-objectstack@latest canary-app …` on node 22, nightly (`cron: '23 3 * * *'`). Scheduled runs: 10-19 `39195688836`, 10-18 `39094122886`, 10-17 `38999220478`, 10-16 `38846306485` all `failure`; 10-15 `38677066775` and 10-14 `38507062813` `success`. Holds.
3. The standing word 「17.x 不再发版本」 is the seat's citation; this seat did not locate its record by search (the search door answered nothing), so it is read as the seat states it. ADR-0120 D7 (staging across 17.x → protocol 18) governs protocol, not release cadence. The `domain:devx` lane is vacant (seat post #6023), so either letter waits for a seat.
4. Not re-run here: the `edgesOut` crash itself (npm 10 on vitest@4.1.12; #23805 / #23806 / #23849 fixed on 18.x) and the green 18.x scaffold run `39194689420` — read from the card.

**Facets:** ① the canary exists to watch what a new user gets, which is `latest`; it is red because that path is broken, so the right end state is a green `latest`, not a canary pointed elsewhere; A re-aims the instrument at `@next` and leaves the front door broken until 18.0 GA, with workflow logic to swing it back; B fixes the door and the canary goes green on its own · ② the strongest pull on the board: every new user on Node 22's npm 10 fails at `npx create-objectstack` today, four days running, and the docs' workaround (#23849) is read after the failure, not before; no one has reported it because the canary is the only one looking · ③ A keeps a red-for-weeks light that teaches everyone to ignore red lights, or hides it; B leaves no silent state · ④ B is M (a 17.x branch release of one package through the `release` environment) against A's S; the exception to 「17.x 不再发版本」 is narrow — the scaffolder package only, the framework packages stay frozen at 17.7.0, the template gains `overrides.vitest` — and it is the maintainer's to grant, which is why the card exists.

**Recommend B.** 口径: `create-objectstack@17.7.1` from the 17.x branch, the generated `package.json` carrying the `overrides.vitest` the 18.x fix uses, nothing else in the package; no framework package is released; the canary stays on `@latest` and is expected green on the first night after publish; the release goes through the `release` environment approval. Not taken: A (re-aims the instrument while the user-facing path stays broken; adds dist-tag logic to a governed workflow), C (a red light nobody reads, until a GA date no card names).

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:金丝雀盯的就是新用户拿到的 `latest`,它红是因为那条路真坏了;终态是 `latest` 变绿,不是把仪器指向别处;B 修门,金丝雀自己变绿。
- ② 实际业务拉动:板上最强的拉动 —— Node 22 自带 npm 10 的每个新用户今天跑 `npx create-objectstack` 都失败,已四天;文档里的绕法是失败之后才读到的。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 留一盏红几周的灯让所有人习惯忽略,或把它藏起来;B 不留静默状态。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:B 是一个包的 17.x 分支发版(M),例外只限脚手架包、框架包仍冻结;A 是 S 但在受管工作流里加 dist-tag 逻辑。

自检:只看①选 B;②③④ 是否翻转:否(④ 偏 A,但不翻字母)。

Pointer · a measurement card precedes this card's letter · director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-19T07:11Z

The maintainer's words in this session's chat, after the director's delta 6261243775 and a reading of who is hit (npm 10 users with no pnpm on PATH, Node 20 / 22's bundled npm; pnpm and npm 11 users are not): 「等我发布了新的 v18 npx create-objectstack问题就能解决吗？要不要派一个卡测试一下」, then 「你只需要创建卡片」. objectstack-ai/objectstack#24487 measures the published `@next` scaffolder on node 22 / npm 10 with pnpm absent (the canary's command against `@next`, with `@latest` as the control). No letter is recorded on this card yet; the maintainer's letter follows that reading. Options A / B / C stand as written; the reading decides whether 18.0 GA moving `latest` closes the new-user path by itself (then C with a dated expectation) or a fix is owed before GA.

Pointer · reading on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24487 ([os-dev-report](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/24487#issuecomment-6262079884), `domain:devx` os-dev, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`): GREEN on `@next`. `npx -y create-objectstack@next` (18.0.0-next.3, both 18.x fixes inside) on node 22 / npm 10.9.4 with pnpm absent installs and passes the canary's validate, build, test and health/ready probe, while the `@latest` control (17.7.0) still reproduces the `edgesOut` crash and `objectstack: not found`. So 18.0 GA moving `latest` is expected to turn the registry canary green on its own, with no 17.x release (limits: next.3 is not GA; only npm 10.9.x measured).

## 席位意见(增量 2 · 读数之后:改荐 C)· director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`), read as batch #371 item 1, 2026-10-19T10:14Z

After the measurement the maintainer asked for (#24487, os-dev-report 6262079884, pointer 6262097446 here): `npx -y create-objectstack@next` (18.0.0-next.3) on node 22 / npm 10.9.4 with pnpm absent installs and passes the canary's validate, build, test and health probe; the `@latest` control (17.7.0) still crashes (`edgesOut`). The maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「等我发布了新的 v18 npx create-objectstack问题就能解决吗？要不要派一个卡测试一下」 · 「你只需要创建卡片」 · 「继续决裁」. Delta 1 (6261243775) recommended B before this reading; this delta replaces it with one recommendation.

**Premises re-run in this act:** dist-tags unchanged (`latest 17.7.0`, `next 18.0.0-next.3`); the reading's limits as the dev stated them — `next.3` is not GA, only npm 10.9.x was measured; the publish-smoke / version-packages PRs of this morning (#24477 merged) will move `next` on, not `latest`.

**Facets, re-read:** ① the end state is a green `latest`, and the reading shows 18.0 delivers it with the fixes already on the line; a 17.x scaffolder release (B) would now be a second fix for a path 18.0 closes, and the canary pointed at `@next` (A) would watch what is already known green · ② the cost of waiting is the window until GA: a first-time user on Node 20 / 22's npm 10 with no pnpm fails at `npm install` until then (docs name the npm 11 / `overrides.vitest` remedy); the maintainer owns the GA date · ③ nothing silent: the canary stays red for a known, measured reason until GA, and turns green on its own the night after; no workflow logic added · ④ zero lines.

**Recommend C — wait for 18.0 GA; no 17.x release; the canary stays on `@latest`.** 口径: this card closes `completed` with the reading as its record; the canary is expected green on the first scheduled run after `latest` moves to 18.0; if it is not, a `domain:devx` card is filed against the GA line. If GA slips far enough that the new-user window matters more than the freeze, that is a new question for the maintainer, asked with the GA date in hand, not a fallback recorded here. Not taken now: A (re-aims the instrument at a path the reading already settled), B (a 17.x exception for a path 18.0 closes).

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:C —— 终态是 `latest` 变绿,读数证明 18.0 自带的修复就能做到;再发 17.x 是给同一条路修第二次,改测 `@next` 是去盯已知绿的路。
- ② 实际业务拉动:等待的代价是到 GA 为止的窗口(Node 20/22 自带 npm 10、没装 pnpm 的新用户装不上);GA 日期在维护者手里。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:无静默项,金丝雀红的原因已实测、GA 次日自己转绿;不加工作流逻辑。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:零行。

自检:只看①选 C;②③④ 是否翻转:否。增量 1 的 B 推荐撤回。

Ruling: batch #371 item 1 · letter C · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-19T10:34Z

Director seat, summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`, on the triage seat's decision card (A leaned by the seat; the director's delta 1 6261243775 recommended B before the measurement; delta 2 6264865193 recommended C after it) (opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6247058702). The maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「等我发布了新的 v18 npx create-objectstack问题就能解决吗？要不要派一个卡测试一下」 · 「你只需要创建卡片」 · then, on delta 2, 「同意」.

**What the ruling binds (letter C — wait for 18.0 GA):**
1. No 17.x release: the freeze 「17.x 不再发版本」 stands; `create-objectstack@17.7.1` is not published.
2. The registry canary stays as it is, on `@latest`, red until `latest` moves to 18.0; no workflow change.
3. The record: #24487's reading (6262079884) — `npx -y create-objectstack@next` (18.0.0-next.3) on node 22 / npm 10.9.4 with pnpm absent installs and passes the canary's probes; the `@latest` control (17.7.0) crashes (`edgesOut`). The expectation: the first scheduled canary run after `latest` moves to 18.0 is green; if it is not, a `domain:devx` card is filed against the GA line that night.
4. The known cost, accepted: until GA, a first-time user on Node 20 / 22's bundled npm 10 with no pnpm fails at `npm install`; the documented remedy (npm 11, or `overrides.vitest`) stands.
Not taken: A (re-aims the canary at `@next`, a path the reading already settled), B (a 17.x exception for a path 18.0 closes).

**Workload of the letter:** zero.

**Execution:** this card leaves `needs-user-decision` and closes `completed`; #24487 closes on its seat's landing note; the `domain:devx` lane watches the first post-GA canary run.

Closed `completed` · ruled C at 6265230846 (batch #371 item 1, the maintainer's 「同意」) · director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-19T10:36Z

Wait for 18.0 GA: no 17.x release, the canary stays on `@latest`; #24487's reading is the record (green on `@next` with npm 10 and no pnpm); the first post-GA canary run is expected green, else a `domain:devx` card.
